stem.zh-CN: 关于[[term:transformer-architecture-families|GPT、BERT、T5 三种模型的架构]]，哪项描述是正确的？
stem.en-US: Which statement correctly describes the architectures of GPT, BERT, and T5?

explanation.zh-CN: GPT系列模型使用[[term:transformer|Transformer]]解码器进行自回归生成，BERT使用Transformer编码器进行双向上下文编码，T5采用[[term:transformer-architecture-families|编码器-解码器架构]]处理序列到序列任务。
explanation.en-US: The GPT family uses a [[term:transformer|Transformer]] decoder for autoregressive generation, BERT uses a Transformer encoder for bidirectional contextual encoding, and T5 uses an [[term:transformer-architecture-families|encoder-decoder architecture]] for sequence-to-sequence tasks.

taxonomy.engineeringStage: E3 架构选型与整体设计

text.en-US: GPT is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|encoder-only]], BERT is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|decoder-only]], and T5 is encoder-decoder
GPT is encoder-decoder, BERT is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|decoder-only]], and T5 is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|encoder-only]]
GPT is encoder-decoder, BERT is encoder-decoder, and T5 is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|decoder-only]]
GPT is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|decoder-only]], BERT is [[term:transformer-architecture-families|encoder-only]], and T5 is encoder-decoder
